The pairs lock first: Finn sits immediately after Hana, and Gus sits immediately after Ann. Hana is before Ann, and Ann is at least three slots after Finn, so Ann is at least four slots after Hana. Gus is before Dev, and Ann is at least three slots from Dev, so Dev is at least seven slots after Hana. Hana can only be in slot 1.

Cara is then two slots after Hana. Dev must be in 9 with Elif in 7 (exactly one slot between them, and Elif cannot fall after Dev). The remaining slots force Ben in 4 and Ivo in 8.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Hana","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Gus","7":"Elif","8":"Ivo","9":"Dev"}
